titulo: Dativo 1: the articles and the pronouns: The dative of articles

aula.titulo: Dativo 1: the articles and the pronouns
aula.objetivo: Understand what the dative is («to whom?»), form the dative of the definite and indefinite articles and of the personal pronouns, and use them with verbs of giving, showing and telling, in the right order.

blocos.texto: Goal of the lesson. By the end of the four sessions, you say “for whom” and “to whom” with dem, der, mir, dir, ihm and ihr, and use the verbs that take the dative (helfen, gefallen, gehören) without swapping it for the accusative.

blocos.contexto: Jonas and Camila choose a present for a friend.

linhas.ru: — Lena hat morgen Geburtstag. Was schenken wir ihr?
linhas.en: — Lena's birthday is tomorrow. What shall we give her?
linhas.audio: Lena hat morgen Geburtstag. Was schenken wir ihr?

linhas.ru: — Ich schenke ihr ein Buch. Das Buch gefällt ihr bestimmt.
linhas.en: — I will give her a book. I am sure she will like the book.
linhas.audio: Ich schenke ihr ein Buch. Das Buch gefällt ihr bestimmt.

linhas.ru: — Gute Idee! Ich zeige dir einen Laden. Der Verkäufer dort hilft uns immer.
linhas.en: — Good idea! I will show you a shop. The salesman there always helps us.
linhas.audio: Gute Idee! Ich zeige dir einen Laden. Der Verkäufer dort hilft uns immer.

linhas.ru: — Danke! Das ist nett von dir.
linhas.en: — Thank you! That is kind of you.
linhas.audio: Danke! Das ist nett von dir.

linhas.ru: — Gern! Und wie geht es dir heute?
linhas.en: — You are welcome! And how are you today?
linhas.audio: Gern! Und wie geht es dir heute?

linhas.ru: — Mir geht es gut. Und dir?
linhas.audio: Mir geht es gut. Und dir?

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: helfen, danken, gehören, gefallen, antworten: all of them take the dative. Memorise the list as one block.
blocos.comparacao: The dative is the case of “to whom” and “for whom”. In English it appears in “I give it to him”, “give him”, “give me”. But there are three traps.

tabela.english: I give the book to the man.
tabela.ingles: Ich gebe dem Mann das Buch.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: the DATIVE answers «wem?» (to whom?). It marks the person who RECEIVES, hears or benefits from the action, the INDIRECT OBJECT: «Ich gebe dem Kind einen Apfel»: what I give is «einen Apfel» (accusative, the direct object), and the one who receives it is «dem Kind» (dative). STEP 2: definite articles in the dative: masculine «dem», feminine «der», neuter «dem», plural «den». STEP 3: indefinite articles: masculine «einem», feminine «einer», neuter «einem»; the plural has no «ein» (with «kein»: «keinen»). STEP 4: in the PLURAL, the noun gets «-n»: «den Kindern», «den Freunden» (except those that already end in -n or -s: «den Eltern», «den Autos»). STEP 5: trick: masculine and neuter are the SAME in the dative (dem, einem); and the feminine «der» is the same as in the genitive. STEP 6: compare the three columns in the table and read aloud, column by column.
blocos.comparacao: In English the indirect object comes with «to» or through word order («I give the apple to the boy», «I give the boy the apple»). In German the preposition disappears and the article changes: «dem Kind».

exemplos.ru: Ich gebe dem Mann das Buch.
exemplos.pt: I give the book to the man.

exemplos.ru: Ich schicke der Frau einen Brief.
exemplos.pt: I send a letter to the woman.

exemplos.ru: Ich schenke dem Kind ein Spielzeug.
exemplos.pt: I give a toy to the child.

exemplos.ru: Ich zeige den Kindern das Foto.
exemplos.pt: I show the photo to the children.

erros.errado: Ich gebe den Mann das Buch.
erros.certo: Ich gebe dem Mann das Buch.
erros.motivo: The one who receives goes into the dative: «dem».

erros.errado: Ich zeige den Kinder das Foto.
erros.certo: Ich zeige den Kindern das Foto.

blocos.enunciado: Say 6 sentences in which you give, show or send something to someone: «Ich gebe dem … / der … / den … Kindern …»
Write the table of articles in the nominative and the accusative, in the four forms (masculine, feminine, neuter and plural).
